question.problem: Consider a triangle $\triangle ABC$, where $m\angle{A} = 55^\circ$, $m\angle B = x + 10^\circ$, and $m\angle C = 3x - 5^\circ.$ Find the value of $x.$
question.worked_solution:
The sum of the measures of the interior angles must be $180^\circ.$ Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}{55}^{∘}+(x+{10}^{∘})+(3x-{5}^{∘}) & ={180}^{∘} \\ {60}^{∘}+4x & ={180}^{∘} \\ 4x & ={120}^{∘} \\ x & ={30}^{∘}.\end{aligned}
$$
